}  .cv-rect .rc-box { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--cv); border-radius: 18px; padding: 10px 16px 10px 14px; position: relative; }  .cv-rect .rc-b1 { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; width: 62%; }  .cv-rect .rc-lo.rc-2col li { break-inside: avoid; }  .cv .theme { font-weight: 700; margin: 6px 0 1px; }  .cv .src { color: #4b5866; font-size: .88em; }  .cv .meta { color: #4b5866; }  .cv b, .cv .gras { font-weight: 700;
